## How to collaborate in an agent-driven environment

<!--
Reflections on why it is hard, from Sam's steers. Issue #9.
-->

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="56%"}
::::: {.stack-grid}
:::: {.cbox .teal}
[🚒]{.emoji} **Why it is hard**

- More changes than any of us can read
- Changes are cheap to write, but checking them costs as much as before
- Hard to tell what a person wrote from what an agent wrote
- The reasoning stays private, in one person's chat with their agent
- Agent-raised issues all look equally urgent
- Agents do not reliably follow conventions we agree
- People differ in access to agents, and in the skills to use them
::::
:::: {.cbox .slate}
[🛠️]{.emoji} **What we are trying**

- Review bots check every change agents propose
- One person clearly in charge of each change
- Labels that mark agent-reviewed work
- Regular check-ins on how it is going
- Next, a shared agent with sign-off from everyone
::::
:::: {.cbox .brick}
[📉]{.emoji} **Not going well**

- Outside contributions to our repositories have dropped right down
- We lose the insight other people bring
::::
:::::
